title: Siege of Nice
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Nice", at revision 1374546456, opens: "The siege of Nice occurred in 1543 and was part of the Italian War of 1542–46 in which Francis I and Suleiman the Magnificent collaborated as part of the Franco-Ottoman alliance against the Holy Roman Emperor Charles V, and Henry VIII of England. At that time, Nice was under the control of Charles III, Duke of Savoy, an ally of Charles V." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q815184, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1543 siege". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
